diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c26e28c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+name: Verify website
+on:
+  pull_request:
+  push:
+    branches: [main, 'feat/**']
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      pages-artifact:
+        type: boolean
+        default: false
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'
+          cache: npm
+      - run: npm ci
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit
+      - run: npm audit --audit-level=high
+      - run: npm run check
+      - run: npm run build
+      - run: npm run export:preview
+      - run: npm run test:e2e
+      - run: npm run audit:lighthouse
+      - name: Retain actual QA evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
+        with:
+          name: qa-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: |
+            docs/evidence/production/
+            test-results/
+          retention-days: 30
+      - name: Upload reviewed static site
+        if: inputs.pages-artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@56afc609e74202658d3ffba0e8f6dda462b719fa # v3
+        with:
+          path: dist
diff --git a/.github/workflows/pages.yml b/.github/workflows/pages.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1cb9f87
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/pages.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+name: Publish approved website
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      approved-commit:
+        description: Full main SHA approved for publication
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      uat-reference:
+        description: Link to the owner's Gate 3 approval
+        required: true
+        type: string
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: pages
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  approval:
+    if: github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Require the explicitly approved main revision and UAT reference
+        env:
+          APPROVED_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.approved-commit }}
+          UAT_REFERENCE: ${{ inputs.uat-reference }}
+        run: |
+          test "$APPROVED_COMMIT" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
+          test -n "$UAT_REFERENCE"
+  verify:
+    needs: approval
+    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml
+    with:
+      pages-artifact: true
+  deploy:
+    needs: verify
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      pages: write
+      id-token: write
+    environment:
+      name: github-pages
+      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/configure-pages@983d7736d9b0ae728b81ab479565c72886d7745b # v5
+      - name: Deploy reviewed artifact
+        id: deployment
+        uses: actions/deploy-pages@368f82528645a54fb793d4d04e342629a3f51346 # v5

@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Maintenance
+
+Use Node 24 and npm ci. Local iteration: npm run dev; static output: npm run build. QA and portable preview commands are in README. Keep minimal copy, CSS tokens and animation timings aligned with the approved design. No secret or external service is required.
+
+Official framework docs/source remain external. Before changing setup claims, inspect current official framework docs and npm availability. Keep dependency updates in reviewable PRs, run audit/type/build/browser/Lighthouse, and update browser binaries for the pinned Playwright version. Preserve font licenses. Review Actions SHA updates against upstream releases.
+
+When an actual setup video is available, review its content, add a poster/dimensions and accessible playback/captions as applicable. It is currently a placeholder, not a failed or delivered recording. External editable design is deferred by owner decision.
+
+Do not refresh screenshot baselines to hide a regression. Only approve new baselines after owner design review. All owner-controlled publication/rollback steps are in release-checklist.md.
diff --git a/docs/delivery/release-checklist.md b/docs/delivery/release-checklist.md
new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+# Release checklist — owner approval required
+
+- [x] Gate 1 requirements and Gate 2 minimal design approved/merged.
+- [ ] Gate 3 UAT checklist reviewed and explicitly accepted by owner, including remaining manual cases/limitations.
+- [ ] Production PR CI green at reviewed SHA; owner merges.
+- [ ] Confirm repository plan/visibility supports Pages and Settings → Pages → Source is GitHub Actions.
+- [ ] Review github-pages environment restrictions; enable owner required review if supported by repository plan.
+- [ ] Owner explicitly approves publication of full main SHA and records Gate 3 approval URL.
+- [ ] Owner dispatches “Publish approved website” on main with that SHA and UAT reference; no push-triggered publication.
+- [ ] Verify successful deployment job and URL https://manh0303.github.io/notth-web/.
+- [ ] On live URL verify HTML and asset HTTP status, title/canonical/social metadata, robots/sitemap/favicon, motion and reduced motion, layout and every official link. Record deployment URL/run ID/commit/time/screenshots in production-verification.md.
+- [ ] Mark release complete only after actual production verification; hand over.
+
+Workflow source: .github/workflows/ci.yml and pages.yml. Actions are pinned to upstream tag SHAs inspected during preparation. Publication runs verification again and uses its exact static artifact. Inputs are passed via environment variables, not interpolated as shell code. The UAT reference is an owner attestation, not an automated authenticity check.
+
+Rollback: owner approves a revert PR for the defective release, CI validates it, then explicitly dispatches the reviewed revert main SHA. Keep deployment and previous commit references. Never force-push main or auto-rollback someone else's work.

+# Maintenance
+

+Official framework docs/source remain external. Before changing setup claims, inspect current official framework docs and npm availability. +Do not refresh screenshot baselines to hide a regression. Only approve new baselines after owner design review. All owner-controlled publication/rollback steps are in release-checklist.md.

+# Release checklist — owner approval required
